scenes.topic_description:
Situation: At the reception desk or on the phone with a clinic receptionist, the learner wants to book a doctor's appointment. It is for the learner, who has had a sore throat and fever for three days and needs a convenient time soon.
Learner: the learner's role is Patient. Partner: the partner's role is Receptionist.
Learner must be able to: say they want to make an appointment; briefly explain the problem in simple words; ask about available times and choose a convenient appointment; give basic personal details if asked.
Partner will: ask what the problem is; offer times or days; ask for the learner's name, phone number, or confirmation.
Not in this scene: describing symptoms in detail, answering medical questions, diagnosis, treatment, medicine instructions.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with appointment calendar and computer, realistic medical office, warm light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: In the doctor's office during the appointment, the learner talks to the doctor about a sore throat and fever that started three days ago. This is the main medical conversation, where the learner needs to explain the problem clearly and understand basic advice.
Learner: the learner's role is Patient. Partner: the partner's role is Doctor.
Learner must be able to: describe the sore throat and fever in simple terms; say when the symptoms started and how strong they are; answer basic questions about other symptoms; understand simple advice and ask what to do next.
Partner will: ask about symptoms, duration, and temperature; ask simple follow-up questions; give basic recommendations or say if medicine, rest, or tests are needed.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, choosing a time, giving contact details, paying at reception, buying medicine at a pharmacy.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I'd like to make an appointment.
messages.text_native: Chcę umówić wizytę.
messages.pronunciation_native: ajd lajk tu mejk en apojntment

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Of course. What seems to be the problem?

check.text_target: What does the receptionist ask about?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Is it something urgent today?
messages.text_native: Czy to coś pilnego na dziś?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I have a sore throat and fever.

messages.pronunciation_native: aj haww e sor trołt end fiwer

check.text_target: What does the receptionist want to know?

options.text_native: Czy potrzebna jest pomoc jeszcze dziś

check.explanation_native: Pytanie dotyczy tego, czy sprawa jest pilna jeszcze tego samego dnia.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: We have today at four or tomorrow at nine.
messages.text_native: Mamy dziś o czwartej albo jutro o dziewiątej.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: It's been for three days.
messages.text_native: To trwa od trzech dni.

check.text_target: Which time is offered for tomorrow?
check.text_native: Jaki termin jest proponowany na jutro?
check.explanation_native: Na jutro recepcjonista proponuje wizytę o dziewiątej rano.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Can I come today at four?
messages.text_native: Czy mogę przyjść dziś o czwartej?
messages.pronunciation_native: ken aj kam tudej et for

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Yes, that time is still free.
messages.text_native: Tak, ten termin jest jeszcze wolny.

check.text_target: What does the receptionist say about four o'clock?

options.text_native: Ten termin może się później zmienić

check.explanation_native: Recepcjonista potwierdza, że termin o czwartej jest wolny.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: I need your full name for the booking.
messages.text_native: Potrzebuję twojego imienia i nazwiska do rezerwacji.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: My name is Jan Kowalski.
messages.text_native: Nazywam się Jan Kowalski.

check.text_target: Which detail does the receptionist ask for?
check.explanation_native: Tutaj recepcjonista prosi o pełne imię i nazwisko.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Please bring your ID and arrive ten minutes early.
messages.text_native: Proszę wziąć dokument tożsamości i przyjść dziesięć minut wcześniej.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Okay, I'll bring my ID.
messages.text_native: Dobrze, wezmę dowód.

check.text_target: How early should the patient arrive?

options.text_target: A quarter of an hour before

check.explanation_native: Recepcjonista prosi, żeby przyjść dziesięć minut wcześniej.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Can I have the address?
messages.text_native: Czy mogę dostać adres?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Yes. It's 12 Green Street, near the pharmacy.
messages.text_native: Tak. To Green Street 12, obok apteki.

check.text_target: What landmark does the receptionist mention?
check.explanation_native: Recepcjonista mówi, że przychodnia jest obok apteki.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: You're booked for today at four with Dr. Lee.
messages.text_native: Jesteś zapisany na dziś na czwartą do doktor Lee.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Okay, see you today at four.
messages.text_native: Dobrze, do zobaczenia dziś o czwartej.
messages.pronunciation_native: okej, si ju tudej et for

check.explanation_native: Recepcjonista potwierdza, że wizyta jest umówiona do doktor Lee.
